name: Familiar
long_description:
Familiar is breaking down every language barrier.

Sales and Demos, Education, Telehealth, Advertising, Live Shopping, Entertainment.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation.

They're building world models for accurate humans: understanding, editing, and predicting.

They started with video language translation, and they've already built one of the most accurate translators available today, the only one that works in real time. It outperforms industry leaders (ElevenLabs, YouTube, HeyGen, Meta), as shown in Familiar's published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

🦋 Content, now in every language. Exactly the same as the original.
